parameters.query: SELECT i.id, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_type, i.net_amount, i.gst_amount, i.pst_amount, i.amount_due, i.holdback_amount, i.issued_date, i.due_date, i.email_sent_at, p.title AS project_name, c.name AS customer_name, c.email, cp.email_from, cp.email_from_name, cp.street_address, cp.city, cp.province, cp.postal_code, cp.phone, cp.signature_name, cp.brand_primary_color, cp.brand_accent_color, cp.brand_success_color, cp.portal_base_url FROM invoices i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id CROSS JOIN company_profile cp WHERE cp.id = 1 AND (i.id::text = $1 OR i.invoice_number = $1) LIMIT 1;
UPDATE invoices SET email_sent_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE (id::text = $1 OR invoice_number = $1) AND email_sent_at IS NULL RETURNING invoice_number;
